entries.title: Merge cards with long proof logs open again
entries.body: A merge card now names each kept proof log on one line, with its size. Press the line to read the log over the card, the way a picture opens, on your Mac or your iPhone. A card too large to open is sent back to the crewmate to make smaller, so you never see one that cannot open.

picture.alt: A proof log open in the log reader, its name and size above its text in the mono face.
